notes: The author asks for a banded block tower and then says plainly that it is a structure to look at, with no interior and no climbing, so the tower itself is the deliverable and this is Entertainment's display case rather than an obby, which the colour-banded tower would otherwise suggest. Stage B answers yes to a space and no to walking through it, which is what set-display exists for and why SET rides alongside P0; there is nothing to traverse, so no jump-gap or reachability work applies. I kept the Display Piece shape and its hero focal build — the tower is the subject — but dropped the photo vignettes and the graphics-scaling cluster, because the author asked for plain simple blocks and those would dress up a build whose whole point is being minimal. With no user to ask I took the stated proportions as the spec, nine wall courses in three bands of three, red at the bottom, orange in the middle, yellow on top, and assumed a default outside viewing position rather than adding a spawn option they never mentioned.
